correctness.rationale: On a zero run the map doubles x, and the conditional zero-digit selector is g(x)=1 on |x|<a/2, p or q on the flanking subintervals and 0 beyond |x|>1/2. Original Dajani–Kalle–Maggioni Lemma 3.8/3.9 gives stationary density 1/(1+a) on |x|<=a at strong matching parameters; their Lemma 3.11 proof gives local L1 continuity, extending plateau to every 1<alpha<3/2, while alpha>=3/2 is explicit. When n>=J, |x|<=2^-n<=a; scaling u=2^(n-1)x makes all selector terms with j>=J equal 1, so exact P(0^n)=2^-n C(a,p). Finite geometric summation yields balanced a(J+2/theta)/(1+a), and biased a^delta F_s(theta)+O_p(a) with nonconstant log-periodic F_s.
